name: dirvi
description: A Vim-inspired terminal UI for browsing directories.

scripts.publish: pnpm build && pnpm --filter dirvi-lib publish --access public && pnpm --filter @mak-98/dirvi-cli publish --access public
scripts.deps:svg: depcruise packages --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph.svg
scripts.deps:svg:lib: depcruise packages/dirvi-lib --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph-lib.svg
scripts.deps:svg:cli: depcruise packages/dirvi-cli --output-type dot | dot -T svg > dependency-graph-cli.svg
